note: Ninja, front view, a short sword in each fist. Head is the black hood, face and beard with the hood tail at the right, bottom y~477 at the beard tip; the jacket with its crossed lapel and sash, and the pennant-like cloth tail beside the right fist are torso. Wide dome sleeves with no bend marked, so the elbows are halfway shoulder-to-wrist: left y~552, right y~570; below that the sleeve down to its diagonal cuff opening is forearm, and the dark gloved fists are hands (left x298-385 y617-735, right x630-724 y672-742). Both swords are gripped, so equipment: the left blade points up-left from the fist (x207-313, y577-690), the right blade points down-right from the fist (x663-790, y737-835), each kept off the hands. Hip is the jacket hem y~800; the trouser band below it plus the bare skin showing above the boots (to y842 left, y850 right) is thigh; the knee is the boot top; ankles at the instep (left y885, right y895).
